purpose.summary: This is a batch COBOL program (SEIKYU1005) that generates group welfare/public expense medical fee claim summary forms (specifically forms 145, 245, 146, 246, 143, 243) for the Japanese ORCA medical receipt software system. It reads indexed claim files and town/insurer number data, performs billing amount calculations including high-cost medical expense limits, and produces printed output.
purpose.domain: healthcare/medical billing (Japanese national health insurance claims processing)

notable_features: No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — pure file-based batch processing
Heavy use of COPY statements with REPLACING for include files (.INC)
Japanese-language comments encoded in latin-1 (actually Shift-JIS/EUC-JP garbled)
79 CALL statements indicating extensive subprogram linkage
OCCURS tables for insurance code lookups
REDEFINES used for hospital name/address splitting
Detailed revision history spanning 2005–2016 with named authors
Part of JMA (Japan Medical Association) open-source ORCA project
SELECT with ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED and DYNAMIC access for claim file
SELECT with LINE SEQUENTIAL for town/insurer number flat file
verdict.notes: The file is encoded in latin-1 per the decoder, but the Japanese comments are actually Shift-JIS or EUC-JP bytes interpreted as latin-1, causing mojibake in the displayed text. The source is clearly genuine production COBOL from the ORCA medical receipt system maintained by JMA Japan. The high comment ratio (44.5%) is largely due to the extensive revision history block at the top. COPY statements reference external .INC copybooks not shown here.
